name: One-Pot Pasta Night
equipment: One large pot or deep skillet
instructions: Add dry pasta directly to a pot with just enough liquid (broth, water, and canned tomatoes) to cover it -- no separate boiling pot needed.
Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed into a light sauce.
Stir in any quick-cooking vegetables (spinach, peas) during the last 2 minutes so they stay bright, not mushy.
Finish with cheese or fresh herbs off the heat -- the residual warmth is enough to melt or wilt them.
